name: bwperim
expr: P4 = bwperim(Sq, 4); P8 = bwperim(Sq, 8); D4 = bwperim(D, 4); D8 = bwperim(D, 8);
comment: MATLAB bwperim — boundary pixels of binary objects. Covers conn=4 and conn=8 on a solid 4x4 square (border on, interior off) and a diagonal+block shape. Pins perimeter counts AND specific pixel on/off states (interior P4(3,3)=0, border P4(2,2)=1). Previously fingerprinted only numel. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b.
